status: SUPERSEDED 2026-08-26 by cfg-interval36.json — v3 (0.7-1.0) recommendation RETRACTED by the n=36 expanded validation (significant quality regression -6.06 +/- 3.85, p=0.003); v2 (0 0.2) confirmed quality-neutral. See cfg-interval36.json for the authoritative verdict.
finding_superseded_note: the n=10 sample (CI +/-5.5 on the total delta) could not resolve v3's true effect; original fields below are preserved unchanged as the historical record
finding: cfg_interval speeds up t2i 20-32% with no measurable quality loss on Qwen-Image-Bench (10-prompt paired, judge = Qwen3.5 27B Q-Judger, official params)

method.generation: SenseNova-U1.5-8B-MoT via this repo's module path, 2048x2048, 50 steps, seed fixed per prompt (gen10.jsonl, 10 prompts), vram_mode balanced, sdpa
method.quality: Qwen/Qwen-Image-Bench judge (27B, Qwen3_5 VL), local int8 weight-only inference, official judge params (temperature 0, thinking on, max_new_tokens 4096, repetition_penalty 1.05); 39 judge tasks per set; paired per-prompt comparison, t_crit(df=9)=2.262

commands.command_template: python -m sensenova_u1_rocm third_party/SenseNova-U1/examples/t2i/inference.py --model_path <ckpt> --vram_mode balanced --attn_backend sdpa --jsonl <prompts> --cfg_scale 4.0 --cfg_norm none --timestep_shift 3.0 --num_steps 50 [--cfg_interval LO HI]

semantics_note: cfg_interval is checked against the timestep_shift=3.0-warped t' = 1 - 3(1-t)/(3-2t), not raw t. At 50 steps: (0,0.2) keeps CFG on first 22 steps (56% skipped); (0.7,1.0) keeps CFG only on last 6 steps (88% skipped). (0,0.7) is nearly a no-op - do not use.
recommendation: v2_cfg_interval_0_0.2 (updated 2026-08-26; original n=10 recommendation was v3_cfg_interval_0.7_1.0, since retracted)
limitations: n=10 prompts (paired) detects ~5-point total shifts; 95% CI on the V3 total delta is about -0.35 +/- 5.5. Judge is local int8 (paired design cancels judge bias). Validated at 2048x2048/50 steps only.
environment: single gfx1100 48GB, bf16, vram_mode balanced, sdpa; judge on same host (int8, CPU vision tower)
